dataset.description:
The data set contains X-ray powder diffraction patterns of Bi2-xSbxTe3 (x=0, 0.2,
0.5, 1.5, 1.8, 2.0) nanoparticles, synthesized utilizing microwave-assisted heating.
Diffraction data were collected at room temperature using a benchtop Rigaku MiniFlex 600 diffractometer with Bragg-Brentano θ-2θ geometry. An X-ray tube with a copper anode (Cu Kα radiation, λ =1.5418 Å), operated at U = 40 kV and I = 15mA, was used as a source.

The dataset is available from Zenodo repository (DOI:10.5281/zenodo.10819489)

distribution.title:

temperature using a benchtop Rigaku MiniFlex 600 diffractometer with Bragg-Brentano θ-2θ geometry. It can be used for XRD data comparisson.

Project leader Ph.D. Inga Pudza. Project duration: 01.01.2024 - 31.12.2026. Total cost: 300 000.00 EUR.
